name: Fatal Decision
author: D.Ranpo
bootlegger: The Imp may choose to kill the Storyteller. If successful, the evil team loses.
The Cerenovus may not choose an evil player, but may choose not to use their ability.
If a mad player is asked to prove they are not mad (e.g., by saying they are mad), doing so does not break madness. However, attempting to prove they are actually mad is a violation.
